title: Classify and model deterministic rule-record mechanics
description:
Finding source:
- Codex readiness reported 306 rule records prose-only.
- Many rules are fine as prose lookup, but some contain deterministic procedures, formulas, or state changes.

Acceptance criteria:
- Classify prose-only rules into: reference/narrative only, deterministic procedure/formula, table-backed rule, duplicate/dedup explanation, and unsupported/needs-design.
- Create child implementation beads for deterministic procedure/formula groups.
- Add readiness output that distinguishes acceptable prose-only rules from actionable mechanics gaps.
notes:
